subject: LOD for Interaction in ScanTwo vs. FitQTL

messages.author: 8012ed629cffed30
messages.subject: LOD for Interaction in ScanTwo vs. FitQTL
parts:
Hello Dr. Broman, 
I am curious about a result I obtained from ScanTwo is not recapitulated in the results of FitQTL.  I used "scantwoperm' to determine the LOD thresholds for declaring multiple QTL on a linkage group empirically. My results indicate there are two QTL on my linkage group of interest, and the interaction term does not surpass this threshold, so I am assuming a purely additive model. However, in the results of fitQTL, adding an interaction term between the two QTL increases the log likelihood of the model, with a significant p-value (although this is a p-value unadjusted for multiple testing). Do you have any recommendations as to what conclusions I can draw from these discordant results ? 

Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] LOD for Interaction in ScanTwo vs. FitQTL
parts:
Adding an interaction term will always increase the LOD score, and so it seems these results are not discordant but rather concern what level of significance you're considering.

karl
